stockwise.subtitle: Inventory Management System
stockwise.overview: A web-based inventory management system designed to organize product data, monitor stock movements, manage suppliers, and generate inventory reports.
stockwise.description: StockWise is an inventory management application developed using Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. The system helps administrators and staff manage product information, record stock transactions, monitor inventory levels, and generate reports. It also implements data validation to maintain stock consistency and prevent negative inventory.
features: Stock In and Stock Out Transactions
challenges: Maintaining accurate stock quantities across multiple inventory transactions.
Preventing inconsistent stock data when multiple transactions are processed.
Handling product imports and validating spreadsheet data.
solutions: Implemented stock calculations based on initial stock and recorded transactions.
Used database transactions and row locking to protect stock consistency.
Added validation for SKU duplication, product data, and inventory transactions.

opstrack.subtitle: Operational Performance Monitoring System
opstrack.overview: An operational monitoring system that helps organizations manage tasks, track work progress, monitor deadlines, verify task completion, and evaluate operational performance.
opstrack.description: OpsTrack is a web-based operational performance monitoring application developed using Laravel and MySQL. The system provides centralized task management, progress tracking, status history, task verification, and dashboard reporting. It uses role-based access control to organize responsibilities between Admin, Manager, and Staff.
challenges: Designing a structured workflow from task assignment to completion verification.
Maintaining a reliable history of task status changes.
Presenting operational performance indicators in a centralized dashboard.
solutions: Implemented role-based task workflows for Admin, Manager, and Staff.
Recorded task status changes to support progress tracking and accountability.
Developed dashboard indicators and reports to support operational monitoring.

peoplecore.subtitle: Human Resource Information System
peoplecore.overview: A human resource information system that integrates employee records, organizational data, attendance, leave management, and HR reporting in one platform.
peoplecore.description: PeopleCore is an HRIS application developed using Laravel and MySQL to support structured employee administration. The system integrates employee records, departments, positions, employment history, attendance, leave requests, leave balances, and HR reports. Role-based access is implemented for Admin, HR, and Employee users.
challenges: Designing relational data structures for employee and organizational information.
Managing leave requests, approvals, and leave balances consistently.
Applying access restrictions based on user roles.
solutions: Implemented relational database structures connecting employees, departments, and positions.
Developed leave management workflows with approval and balance tracking.
Applied validation and role-based authorization to maintain data consistency and access control.

bengtix.subtitle: Event Ticket Management System
bengtix.overview: A web-based ticket management system designed to organize event information, ticket categories, locations, orders, and administrative activities.
bengtix.description: BengTix is an event ticket management application developed using Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. The system focuses on organizing event data and supporting administrative workflows through centralized management of events, ticket types, categories, locations, and ticket-related records.
challenges: Organizing event and ticket information into a structured application.
Maintaining consistent relationships between events, locations, categories, and ticket types.
Improving the usability and visual consistency of administrative interfaces.
solutions: Organized event-related data through separate management modules.
Used relational database structures to connect event information and ticket records.
Improved the interface through reusable components and a consistent design system.

sismenkes.subtitle: Healthcare Management System
sismenkes.overview: A healthcare management system that centralizes patient registration, doctor information, medical schedules, and medicine inventory.
sismenkes.description: SISMENKES is a web-based healthcare information system developed using Laravel and MySQL. It supports healthcare administration through patient data management, doctor information, schedule management, and medicine inventory. The application provides an integrated interface for managing healthcare-related information.
challenges: Connecting patient, doctor, schedule, and medicine information in a relational database.
Improving the interface to make the system easier to use.
solutions: Designed relational database structures for healthcare-related information.
Organized application functionality into dedicated management modules.
Improved the interface and registration experience to provide a more consistent user experience.

sistem-pengajuan-surat-desa.subtitle: Village Administration Information System
sistem-pengajuan-surat-desa.overview: A web-based village administration system that enables residents to submit certificate requests online and helps village staff manage administrative services.
sistem-pengajuan-surat-desa.description: This application was developed as an undergraduate final project using Laravel and MySQL. It digitizes the village certificate submission process and supports administrative activities through resident management, online submissions, document generation, and administrative monitoring.
challenges: Designing an efficient database structure for village administration.
Implementing role-based authentication and access control.
solutions: Designed relational MySQL tables for the application.
Implemented authentication and middleware to manage user access.
Integrated PDF generation to support administrative document processing.
